basic_info.description: Welcome to a charming gem of a home in the heart of San Francisco, located at 1653 17th Avenue. Built in 1931, this delightful home, freshly painted inside and out, offers a captivating blend of old-world charm and modern amenities.     The main level features two spacious bedrooms that offer striking ocean views and breathtaking sunsets, complemented by a convenient split bath. As you step inside the formal entry, the warmth of gleaming hardwood floors greets you, and a cozy fireplace in the living room enhances the inviting atmosphere.    The property sits on a generous lot, featuring a nice-sized yard perfect for enjoying sunny afternoons or hosting gatherings. Downstairs is a bonus room staged as a bedroom, complete with a bathroom and a flex space where you'll find laundry hookups, offering versatility for various lifestyle needs. Additionally, a massive garage provides ample storage and workspace.    This home is an ideal retreat, offering both tranquility and proximity to the vibrant amenities the Inner Sunset has to offer, including restaurants, shopping, transportation and Golden Gate Park. Experience the unique allure of this fabulous, classic home today.
